mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (as of t-1mo), 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI (above 228.0) signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to rising real rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 228.0 (as of t-2mo), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment rate (above 8.0%) and falling employment (below 133,000 thousand) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0 and PAYEMS < 133000 (as of t-1mo), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 700 thousand (HOUST < 700) signals a demand slowdown in the housing sector, which correlates with broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 700 (as of t-2mo), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a supply-side contraction, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100 (as of t-2mo), 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 700) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a dual demand-supply contraction, which intensifies economic uncertainty and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 700 AND INDPRO < 100 (as of t-2mo), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (UNRATE < 8.0%), the declining unemployment rate signals improving economic conditions, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 8.0 (as of t-1mo), 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales and financial services (RSAFS > 400000 million) signals robust consumer and business demand, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 400000 (as of t-1mo), 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.
